name: Liothyronine
halfLifeSource: FDA label for Liothyronine Sodium (liothyronine), Clinical Pharmacology/Pharmacokinetics — biological t½ ≈ 2.5 days
halfLifeNotes: The label states a biological half-life of about 2.5 days for T3; T3 is also produced endogenously from T4 deiodination, which complicates single-value kinetics.
